import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { notes } from "../../../backend/schema/notes";

// A board over "status" fits this table, but a board needs a text column to keep each card's order in. Add one, then declare kanban: { columnField: "status", orderField: "<that column>" }.
export const notesCms = customizeTable<typeof notes>("notes", {
    display: {
        title: "description"
    },
    listFields: ["id", "status", "closedAt", "userIp", "latitude", "longitude"],
    fields: {
        description: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "status",
        "closedAt",
        "userIp",
        "latitude",
        "longitude",
        "tile",
        "user",
        "description",
        "createdAt",
        "updatedAt"
    ]
});
